puzzles.ruleText: Every shape is outlined, and no two shapes have the same type.
Every shape is a drop, and the two shapes point in opposite directions.
Every shape is small, and one shape points straight at the other.
Every shape is striped, and the two shapes sit in neighbouring cells, sharing a side.
Every shape is a half-disc, and the large shape sits higher than the small one.
Every shape points left, and no two shapes have the same fill.
Every shape is small, and no two shapes have the same type.
Every shape points up, and the shapes share a row or a column.
Every shape is outlined, and one shape points straight at the other.
Every shape sits in the left column, and no two shapes have the same fill.
